title: Training-Free Character-Length Control in Summarization with Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06371v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Summarization with a fixed character length is important for tasks such as headline and article preview generation, where text must fit an exact space. Autoregressive language models (LMs) struggle with precise character-length control: training-based methods require task-specific fine-tuning, while zero-shot prompting strategies achieve only approximate compliance. We propose DELTA (Diffusion Expected Length Targeting Algorithm), a training-free inference-time method for masked diffusion LMs that estimates expected character length at each denoising step and dynamically inserts or removes masked positions to steer toward a target length. DELTA requires no fine-tuning and is designed for off-the-shelf masked diffusion LMs. Across three summarization benchmarks, it reduces character-length errors by an order of magnitude compared to baselines while maintaining competitive summary quality in both automatic and human evaluation.

translated_title: 基于扩散语言模型的免训练摘要字符长度控制
translated_abstract: 固定字符长度的摘要生成对于标题和文章预览生成等任务非常重要，因为这些任务中的文本必须精确适配特定空间。自回归语言模型（LM）难以实现精确的字符长度控制：基于训练的方法需要针对特定任务的微调，而零样本提示策略只能达到近似的长度要求。我们提出了DELTA（Diffusion Expected Length Targeting Algorithm，扩散期望长度定向算法），这是一种面向掩码扩散语言模型的免训练推理时方法，它在每个去噪步骤中估计期望字符长度，并通过动态插入或删除掩码位置来引导模型朝向目标长度。DELTA无需微调，专为现成的掩码扩散语言模型设计。在三个摘要基准测试中，与基线方法相比，它将字符长度误差降低了一个数量级，同时在自动评估和人工评估中都保持了有竞争力的摘要质量。
tldr: 提出免训练推理时算法DELTA，通过在扩散语言模型的每个去噪步骤中估计期望字符长度并动态插入或删除掩码位置，实现对摘要字符长度的精确控制，将长度误差降低了一个数量级。
